contributions.statement: Re-run security tests and SAST on regenerated code after any spec or prompt edit, including typo-level ones, and never treat spec wording as a security control: single-character mutations, most damaging in the docstring/spec part of the prompt, flipped generated code between secure and vulnerable more often than they fixed it.
contributions.evidence: §4.2 Figs. 1-2, 5 and App. A (mutation flips across 3 open code LLMs, 5 languages, multiple-testing correction); §4.3 (mid-prompt/spec mutations most harmful). Single-function CWEval tasks, open models only, no Java, no agent loop.
relative_to: prompts are not a security control / LLM output nondeterminism

reason: A well-controlled fragility result that turns into a concrete gate trigger for spec-driven teams: spec edits re-trigger security checks. Hidden-state probes are not actionable with hosted models and are not used.
